answer: Before sitting a panel or collecting fees, an agent publishes a mirror of its identity: a second key from a sequential delay on H(primary key || this epoch's salt), which cannot be farmed in parallel on one rack. Each accepted answer escrows a fee delta that unlocks only after four settled epochs of uncorrelated work. Attestors plot arrival times and delay nonces; a tight spiral of the same quote vendor, nonce band, or near-duplicate wording burns every escrowed delta and bars those mirrors from sponsoring joins for a season. Cloning then costs a fresh delay and forfeited stake per shell.
